title: Tiny Takeover Backport
description: A Minecraft mod that brings the complete Tiny Takeover drop to older Minecraft versions!
body: # Tiny Takeover Backport **Tiny Takeover Backport** brings features from the official **Tiny Takeover** (26.1) game drop back to older Minecraft versions! ## Features All backported features use the `minecraft:` namespace (e.g., `minecraft:golden_dandelion`) to ensure seamless world migration when updating to Minecraft 26.1+. ### Redesigned Baby Mobs - Backports updated models, textures, and properties for baby variants. ### Adult Rabbit Model - Backports the updated adult rabbit model along with the new hitbox. ### Golden Dandelion: - Crafted by surrounding a dandelion with gold nuggets. - Right-click any baby mob with a Golden Dandelion to **lock their age/growth**, keeping them tiny forever! Right-clicking again will unlock their growth. - Can be potted in flower pots, crafted into Suspicious Stew, or used for Piglin trading. ### Craftable Name Tags - Crafted using any nugget and paper. ## Mod Compatibility - **Vanilla Backport**: When loaded alongside [Vanilla Backport](https://modrinth.com/mod/vanillabackport/), the mod features additional support for their backported warm/cold mob variants. ## Known Issues - **Quark** > Disable "Variant Animal Textures" in the config - **Vanilla Backport** > Disable "Use Sheep Wool Undercoat" in client config - **Environmental** > Disable "Baby Chicken Texture" in client config - **Personality** > Disable "Sheep Fur Overlay" in client config - **Mixed Litter** > Disable their conflicting variants in mixed_litter-startup.toml ## Configuration The mod is fully configurable using an in-game config screen (requires **[YetAnotherConfigLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl)**). You can: - Toggle baby models individually for each mob type. - This even supports hot reloading! - Enable/disable the adult rabbit model replacement. - Toggle the craftable Name Tag recipe. ### ⚠️ Disclaimer This mod is in no way affiliated with or endorsed by Mojang, Microsoft, or any of their subsidiaries. Minecraft is a trademark of Mojang Studios. All related assets, including textures, names, and game content, are the property of Mojang Studios and Microsoft.
